description: nemar-ica 1.0.0-b2: the independent-component decomposition of one EEG recording, computed by pAMICA through eegprep (or by the AMICA binary, recorded as such), with ASR's state and ICLabel's probabilities; no samples are written.

browser_transform.applies_to: serving_copy channels matched by label, in microvolts: the view converts by the store's unit field and refuses an unknown unit or any channel it cannot match
browser_transform.caption: not checked against the decomposition input
browser_transform.note: no preprocessing; activations approximate the decomposition input

asrBurstFraction.description: Share of the samples artifact subspace reconstruction repaired.

durationS.description: Duration of the samples the floor read.

icaRank.description: Rank of the decomposition: one less than the good channels, for the average reference.

lineNoiseAfterDb.description: Line-noise excess after the band-stop filters, at whichever of 50 and 60 Hz had the larger excess before them.

lineNoiseBeforeDb.description: Line-noise excess before the band-stop filters, at whichever of 50 and 60 Hz had the larger excess before them.

nChannelsInput.description: Channels in the recording, of every type.

nGoodChannels.description: EEG channels the floor judged good.

nNoiseOnlyChannels.description: EEG channels without coordinates, judged on the noise criterion only.

nNotAssessedChannels.description: EEG channels no criterion could judge.

nSignalChannels.description: Channels typed EEG, the ones the floor assesses.

percentGoodChannels.description: Share of the EEG channels the floor judged good.

percentGoodSamples.description: Share of the samples outside the bad windows the floor found.

samplingRateHz.description: Sampling rate of the samples the floor read.

views.caption: Scalp maps of the independent components, each with its share of the variance and its ICLabel probabilities.

Component activations computed in your browser from the serving copy, with no preprocessing; they approximate the decomposition's input, the dataset's own recording filtered and repaired with artifact subspace reconstruction.

Independent components counted by their most probable ICLabel class. Beside each class X is the summed variance of components classed X: the sum of each component's own share of the data's variance, not the variance the class explains, since the components are not orthogonal.
